splash.error: Studio cannot start ({reason}). Make sure that govee-server runs, then reload.
mobile.title: Open Studio on a phone or tablet
mobile.scan: Scan the code with the camera of a phone or a tablet on the same network.
mobile.off: Share Studio on this network, then scan the code with a phone or a tablet.
mobile.warning: While sharing is on, any device on this network can control the lights. Sharing stops when the server stops.
mobile.fixed: govee-server listens on the network (--listen): any device on it can control the lights.
mobile.elsewhere: Only the computer that runs govee-server can switch sharing.
